mapper.sql: SELECT id, entity_type, action_type, entity_id, brand_id, summary, before_data, after_data, status, requested_by, requested_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, apply_error FROM audit_request
mapper.select: WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_request (entity_type, action_type, entity_id, brand_id, summary, before_data, after_data, status, requested_by) VALUES (#{entityType}, #{actionType}, #{entityId}, #{brandId}, #{summary}, #{beforeData, typeHandler=com.wdd.backend.mapper.JsonObjectTypeHandler}, #{afterData, typeHandler=com.wdd.backend.mapper.JsonObjectTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{requestedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, apply_error = #{applyError} WHERE id = #{id}
